title: [nightly/speed] Serve the landing hero photo as WebP
summary: The landing page's hero scorecard photo goes from a 210 kB JPEG to a 97 kB WebP (quality 85, handwriting kept sharp), with the JPEG as a fallback for old browsers. It's the first thing a signed-out visitor sees, and after the lazy-route work it was bigger than all the landing page's JS.
